node.statement: Equation (1.1) uses rho_AI:=eta_A and defines rho_T as a minimum containing rho_AI and epsilon_E/C_A. Hence 0<=eta<=rho_T gives 0<=eta<=eta_A and C_A*eta<=epsilon_E. Applying lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization to the nonzero H, UCP Phi, and cb-defect bound fixed in 1.1.1.1 yields epsilon_AI(eta)<=C_A*eta<=epsilon_E (and supplies the extended epsilon_AI(eta)-C*-algebra structure used by sibling 1.1.2).
